name: 36201 · Anniston, AL
findings: ZIP 36201 (Anniston) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36201 (Anniston) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 36201 (Anniston) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).
